Sub Query または Materialized View を使った例。
```CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW commented_articles
AS
SELECT
	a.id AS article_id,
	a.updated_at AS article_updated_at,
	MAX(c.updated_at) AS latest_commented_at
FROM articles AS a
LEFT OUTER JOIN comments AS c
ON c.article_id = a.id
GROUP BY a.id;

CREATE INDEX commented_articles_latest_index ON commented_articles(
	latest_commented_at DESC NULLS FIRST,
	article_updated_at DESC
);

SET enable_seqscan TO 'off';

-- use SUBQUERY
EXPLAIN
SELECT
	s.id,
	MAX(s.updated_at) AS t
FROM (
	SELECT
		a.id,
		c.updated_at
	FROM articles AS a
	LEFT OUTER JOIN comments AS c
	ON c.article_id = a.id
	ORDER BY c.updated_at DESC NULLS FIRST
) AS s
GROUP BY s.id
LIMIT 10
OFFSET 11;

-- use MATERIALIZED VIEW
EXPLAIN
SELECT
	a.id,
	c.latest_commented_at
FROM articles AS a
INNER JOIN commented_articles AS c
ON c.article_id = a.id
ORDER BY c.latest_commented_at DESC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 10
OFFSET 11;```
```                                                            QUERY PLAN
----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Limit  (cost=283.81..283.91 rows=10 width=12)
   ->  HashAggregate  (cost=283.70..285.70 rows=200 width=12)
         Group Key: a.id
         ->  Sort  (cost=253.95..258.20 rows=1700 width=12)
               Sort Key: c.updated_at DESC
               ->  Hash Right Join  (cost=91.06..162.74 rows=1700 width=12)
                     Hash Cond: (c.article_id = a.id)
                     ->  Index Scan Backward using comments_updated_at_index on comments c  (cost=0.15..67.70 rows=1570 width=12)
                     ->  Hash  (cost=69.65..69.65 rows=1700 width=4)
                           ->  Index Only Scan using articles_pkey on articles a  (cost=0.15..69.65 rows=1700 width=4)

                                                         QUERY PLAN
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 Limit  (cost=2.91..5.27 rows=10 width=12)
   ->  Nested Loop  (cost=0.30..402.61 rows=1700 width=12)
         ->  Index Scan using commented_articles_latest_index on commented_articles c  (cost=0.15..69.65 rows=1700 width=12)
         ->  Index Only Scan using articles_pkey on articles a  (cost=0.15..0.20 rows=1 width=4)
               Index Cond: (id = c.article_id)```
